seo.title: Electrical, MEP & Project Engineering in Morocco | Salimi Engineering
seo.description: Salimi Engineering is a Morocco-based engineering bureau delivering electrical, MEP, owner-side and project support with teams scaled to each assignment.

hero.title: Design the systems. Control the site. Deliver the project.
hero.summary: Salimi Engineering is a Morocco-based engineering bureau supporting owners, developers and international teams with design, contractor review, site supervision and project delivery. We scale the project team to the required disciplines and workload.
hero.trust: Founder-led · Project-specific teams · Engineering design · Site supervision

audiences: Need a local engineering team in Morocco
Need systems tested and handed over

services.eyebrow: What we can take off your desk
services.title: An engineering bureau scaled to the project
services.summary: From a focused technical review to a medium-sized project assignment, we build the delivery team around the required disciplines, workload and site presence.

items.title: Owner-side engineering & supervision
items.text: Define the scope, review designs and bids, challenge changes, inspect the works and give the owner clear technical recommendations.

items.title: Electrical, ventilation & MEP design
items.text: Calculations, power distribution, lighting, ventilation layouts, life-safety interfaces, specifications and coordinated construction drawings.

items.title: Local project and site support
items.text: Site surveys, contractor coordination, technical meetings, progress evidence, issue resolution, testing and handover support in Morocco.

items.title: Design
items.text: Translate operational needs into calculations, layouts, diagrams, specifications and buildable technical solutions.

items.title: Coordinate
items.text: Resolve interfaces between electrical, ventilation, fire-safety, architecture, structure and contractors before they become site delays.

items.title: Supervise
items.text: Review submittals and substitutions, inspect works, record non-conformities and verify corrective actions.

items.title: Deliver
items.text: Follow testing, commissioning, snag closure, documentation and handover until the systems are ready for operation.

founder.title: Senior accountability stays direct as the project team grows.
founder.text: Salimi Engineering is led by its founder and lead engineer, who remains responsible for technical quality and the client relationship. Engineers and project specialists are engaged or hired to match each assignment, allowing the bureau to handle focused tasks and medium-sized project scopes.
founder.quote: The team can grow with the project. Technical responsibility stays clear.
founder.imageAlt: Founder and lead engineer of Salimi Engineering, seated at a desk in a naturally lit office.

contact.eyebrow: A technical problem is enough to start
contact.title: Tell us what is blocking your project.
contact.text: A first call can clarify the problem, the documents available, the site conditions and the fastest useful intervention.
